profile.headline: System Software Engineer at Panasonic
profile.summary: Hands-on Lab Engineering with 4 years of experience supporting post-silicon system validation, thermal testing, and hardware bring-up of AI server platforms in laboratory and data center environments. Experienced in assembling, configuring, and validating CPU, GPU, NIC, BMC, and server hardware while troubleshooting hardware, firmware, and system-level issues using Linux and engineering diagnostic tools. Skilled in BIOS/BMC firmware updates, thermal qualification, root-cause analysis, and board-level debugging. Recognized for collaborating effectively with cross-functional engineering teams, maintaining validation infrastructure, and supporting the successful qualification of next-generation AI server platforms.

positions.title: Test Engineering Specialist
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Performed thermal bring-up and validation of next-generation AI server platforms, verifying functionality and
thermal performance of CPU, GPU, DUT, NIC, BMC, and HMC subsystems throughout the engineering
qualification cycle.
• Executed thermal interface material (TIM) attachment, re-attachment, and imprint analysis to evaluate
contact quality, optimize heat transfer, and ensure compliance with engineering validation requirements.
• Conducted thermal stress, environmental, and reliability testing across low- and high-temperature operating
conditions to verify platform stability, cooling efficiency, and hardware performance.
• Diagnosed hardware bring-up failures, including DUT boot failures, GPU detection issues, NIC initialization
failures, thermal controller faults, and post-reboot connectivity problems using Linux, BMC, and engineering
diagnostic tools.
• Configured, flashed, upgraded, and recovered BIOS, BMC, firmware, and operating system images to support
hardware qualification, system recovery, and engineering validation activities.
• Collaborated with hardware, firmware, software, thermal, and system validation engineers to reproduce
complex failures, validate engineering fixes, and support new platform bring-up and qualification.
• Executed thermal validation using KCX-controlled test systems, diagnosing temperature control,
environmental stability, and automated test setup issues to improve test reliability.
• Automated validation workflows using Linux shell scripting and Python to improve test efficiency, reduce
manual effort, and accelerate debug turnaround.
• Documented validation results, root-cause investigations, engineering risks, and corrective actions using
internal tracking systems to support design reviews and product release readiness.
• Partnered with cross-functional engineering teams to improve validation workflows, expand test coverage, and
enhance overall laboratory productivity.

positions.title: MFG Test Engineering
positions.description:
-Executed rack-level functional, pretest, burn-in (RUNIN), and final system testing on Oracle GB200 GPU compute platforms to validate shipment readiness and long-term reliability.
-Validated end-to-end system stability across compute trays, NVSwitch trays, power shelves, PMCs, cable cartridges, and rack infrastructure in high-density GPU environments.
-Performed root-cause analysis of complex hardware failures involving GPUs, NVSwitches, NVLink, PCIe, NICs (CX7/CX8), BMC/ILOM, PMCs, and power subsystems.
-Diagnosed NVSwitch NVOS version mismatches, CLI access failures, and health status errors using ONIE recovery, PXE firmware workflows, and serial console access.
-Debugged NVLink bandwidth stress failures, BER threshold violations, and connectivity pre-check errors through topology mapping and GPU-to-switch correlation.
-Investigated PCIe compare failures, GPU enumeration issues, and “fallen off bus” events using Linux logs, kernel diagnostics, and ILOM fault data.
-Resolved BIOS and SBIOS deadlocks, TPM detection issues, and platform initialization failures impacting system bring-up and test progression.
-Isolated power-related issues by validating PSU detection, PMC behavior, I2C communication, FRU data integrity, and GPIO sequencing at rack scale.
-Troubleshot network and cabling issues across fiber, DAC, and RJ45 connections, verifying Arista TOR switch interfaces, link status, and negotiated speeds.
-Leveraged internal automation tools (jumpin, find_ip, ilom, L15H_UUT_hostup.py) and Linux/Bash scripting to automate diagnostics, power cycling, log collection, and targeted retesting.
-Analyzed rack-level logs, diagnostic flags, and sensor data to identify failure patterns, perform targeted reruns, minimize downtime, and improve production throughput.
-Documented debug procedures, corrective actions, and shift handoffs while training new technicians on L11 testing, Linux usage, and structured hardware debug workflows.

positions.title: Quality Engineering (SAR & RF Intern)
positions.description:
• Performed SAR and EMC testing on wireless devices to ensure compliance with FCC and ISED regulatory standards. 
• Evaluated RF shielding, power density, and human exposure safety for antennas, wearables, and wireless routers 
under various operating conditions. Utilized automation platforms including SPEAG DASY6/DASY8 and ETS Lindgren EM-Quest for exposure measurement validation. 
• Supported the development of a Fully Automated Test Environment (ATE) using Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib) and LabVIEW, reducing manual effort by 30% and increasing test consistency. 
• Conducted data analysis to detect anomalies and confirm RF and EMC system behavior using Minitab, Excel, and  Python scripts. Created test plans, validation protocols, and regulatory submission reports aligned with CGMP, ISO 9001, and FDA 21 CFR Part 820. 
• Executed Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and process capability studies (Cp, Cpk) to assess test accuracy  and repeatability. Helped in calibration, preventive maintenance, and traceability of RF/SAR test equipment,  ensuring compliance with ISO/IEC 17025. 
• Applied Design for Test (DfT) and Quality by Design (QbD) principles to optimize SAR validation and reduce failure risks during regulatory approvals. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional engineering teams to troubleshoot test failures, signal integrity issues, and compliance-related risks. 
• Improved lab documentation processes to align with UL internal standards and ISO/IEC requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · ATE · Agile Methodologies · SAR · Document Management · Radio Frequency (RF) · Automatic Test Equipment · 5S · DASYLab · Quality Control · Python (Programming Language) · Process Capability

positions.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer-Quality & Process Improvement
positions.description:
• Conducted in-process inspections and quality audits on automotive, solar, tubular, and VRLA battery lines, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001:2015 and driving production consistency. 
• Performed detailed performance testing on batteries, including charge/discharge cycles, voltage drop, thermal stress, leakage, and runtime to validate product reliability. 
• Applied Lean Six Sigma and DMAIC methodologies to streamline production processes, improve yield, and reduce cycle time. 
• Created and supported SOPs, Control Plans, Quality Inspection Plans (QIPs), and Safe Launch documentation to support audits and standardize manufacturing operations. 
• Led PFMEA sessions for high-risk battery processes and implemented effective mitigation actions to reduce failure modes and improve process reliability. 
• Managed customer and internal quality concerns through 8D problem-solving, using tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagrams, Pareto Analysis, and PDCA. 
• Enhanced traceability by proposing and supporting real-time tracking solutions for components and equipment across production lines. 
• Performed statistical analysis and control chart monitoring to identify early deviations and maintain process capability. 
• Supported implementation of 5S within the Quality Lab to improve workplace organization, safety, and inspection workflow efficiency. 
• Collaborated with supply chain and production teams to reduce lead times, refine equipment flow, and address bottlenecks. 
• Updated technical documentation in alignment with evolving battery designs, customer requirements, and regulatory standards. 
• Participated in Kaizen and continuous improvement workshops focused on waste reduction, battery performance, and process robustness.
positions.insights: Skills: cGMP manufacturing · Manufacturing Operations Management · Pareto Charts · 8D Problem Solving · Process Failure Mode Effects Analysis (PFMEA) · Kaizen · Statistical Data Analysis · 5 Why · 5S · Quality Control · Process Capability

positions.title: Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) panels for automation systems used in industrial field  applications. 
• Collaborated with hardware and software teams to integrate PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems for real-time  monitoring and remote control. 
• Performed SWOT analysis and feasibility studies to support new product development, resulting in a 10% cost reduction through design improvements. 
• Prepared and reviewed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts for RTU system builds and testing. 
• Improved control logic and wiring architecture, which enhanced assembly speed and reduced on-site installation time. 
• Participated in on-site commissioning and troubleshooting of RTU systems to ensure smooth deployment and client satisfaction. 
• Worked closely with design, QA, and manufacturing teams to deliver projects on time and meet quality requirements. 
• Managed BOMs, technical documentation, and lifecycle records to support internal workflows and client audits. 
• Conducted system validation, including dry-run simulations, loop checks, and final inspections prior to system deployment. 
• Delivered presentations and provided technical support during FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) phases. 
• Automated recurring design and documentation tasks using Excel macros and basic scripts, saving time, and reducing manual errors. 
• Coordinated with procurement to find cost-effective components, improving system performance while staying within budget and lead time. 
• Ensured all panel designs met applicable electrical safety standards and industry regulations.
